description: Handles FAQ lookups (e.g. MOQ, imprint methods, shipping, returns) for the Chatbot POC. Content adapted in summary form from MARCO Promos' public ordering FAQ page.

faqs.question: How do I place an order?
faqs.answer: Orders can be placed online by choosing a product, quantity, and uploading artwork, or by working directly with a promo specialist over phone, live chat, or email.

faqs.question: Do I need an account to order?
faqs.answer: An account is not required, but having one lets you save artwork, view order history, and reorder more easily.

faqs.question: What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ)?
faqs.answer: MOQ differs by product and is listed in the pricing table on each product's page.

faqs.question: Is there special pricing for bulk or recurring orders?
faqs.answer: Larger quantities unlock discounted price tiers, and custom quotes are available for ongoing corporate programs.

faqs.question: Can I reorder a previous item?
faqs.answer: Yes, artwork is kept on file for at least a year, so reordering is possible via account history or a previous order number.

faqs.question: Can I see a sample before I buy?
faqs.answer: Free samples are generally offered to verified businesses; items outside the free program may carry a small fee, which is credited back if an order is placed or the sample is returned within 30 days. Sample requests are typically limited to about 5 items.

faqs.question: Can I get a sample with my logo on it?
faqs.answer: Yes, custom logo (spec) samples are available for a small setup fee and may need extra production time.

faqs.question: How long does sample delivery take?
faqs.answer: Standard samples typically ship within a few business days, while custom logo samples take longer depending on the decoration method.

faqs.question: What imprint methods do you offer?
faqs.answer: Available decoration methods include screen printing, embroidery, laser engraving, digital full-color printing, debossing, direct-to-garment, and others depending on the product.

faqs.question: Will the imprint color match my brand exactly?
faqs.answer: Pantone (PMS) color matching is offered on most items, though slight variation can occur depending on the material being printed on.

faqs.question: Do you offer eco-friendly or sustainable products?
faqs.answer: Yes, a dedicated range of recycled, reusable, and responsibly sourced products is available.

faqs.question: What artwork file types do you accept?
faqs.answer: Vector files (AI, EPS, PDF) are preferred for the sharpest print quality; high-resolution PNG or JPG files are also accepted.

faqs.question: What if I don't have a high-quality logo file?
faqs.answer: Basic artwork cleanup and formatting is generally offered at no charge, and a specialist can help trace, recolor, or otherwise prepare a logo for imprinting.

faqs.question: Can I use AI-generated images for my imprint?
faqs.answer: AI-generated images are usually low-resolution and can look blurry once enlarged for print; the art team can often recreate or vectorize the design to get a print-ready result.

faqs.question: Will I see a proof before my order is printed?
faqs.answer: A free digital proof is provided for every order, and production begins only after final approval.

faqs.question: How do I know I'm getting the best price?
faqs.answer: Pricing is transparent and includes the product cost, quantity discounts, and clearly stated setup fees, with a price-match guarantee versus equal-quality competitor products.

faqs.question: What is a setup fee?
faqs.answer: A setup fee is a one-time charge to create the screens, dies, or plates needed for a specific logo; it is waived on exact reorders.

faqs.question: How long is my quote valid?
faqs.answer: Quotes remain valid for 30 days, with the expiration date clearly noted.

faqs.question: What is the standard turnaround time?
faqs.answer: Most items are produced within about 5 to 10 business days after proof approval, with shipping adding roughly 3 to 5 more days, though this varies by product and imprint method.

faqs.question: Do you offer rush production?
faqs.answer: Free 24-hour production is available on hundreds of items; look for the rush indicator or ask a representative for expedited options.

faqs.question: How much does shipping cost?
faqs.answer: Shipping cost depends on the product, order size, shipping method, and delivery destination.

faqs.question: Can I ship to multiple locations?
faqs.answer: Split shipments to multiple offices or remote teams are supported, though additional shipping fees may apply.

faqs.question: Will I receive tracking information?
faqs.answer: Tracking information is provided once an order ships so delivery can be monitored.

faqs.question: Can I use my own shipping account?
faqs.answer: Customers can often use their own shipping account; this should be communicated to the representative at the time of ordering.

faqs.question: Can I ship internationally?
faqs.answer: International shipping is possible for many products, but availability varies; a FedEx or UPS account number is typically required, and a foreign document fee applies.

faqs.question: Can I change my order after it's placed?
faqs.answer: Changes may be limited or incur extra costs once artwork is approved and production has begun, so requests should be made as early as possible.

faqs.question: Can I cancel my order?
faqs.answer: Cancellation may not be possible once production has started, and charges may apply for completed work; a representative can review the order status.

faqs.question: What is your return policy?
faqs.answer: Because items are custom-branded, returns are generally only accepted for manufacturing defects or printing errors.

faqs.question: What if there is an error with my order?
faqs.answer: Orders that arrive damaged or differ from the approved proof should be reported within 15 business days of delivery for resolution via replacement or credit; a partial return of product may be required for full refunds.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: Major credit cards and other approved business payment methods are accepted.

faqs.question: When is my credit card charged?
faqs.answer: The card is authorized at the time of order, but funds are only collected once the order ships.

faqs.question: Why am I being charged sales tax?
faqs.answer: Sales tax is collected in states where required by law, based on the shipping destination.

faqs.question: Are tax-exempt orders supported?
faqs.answer: Customers can email their tax-exemption certificate so tax can be removed from the final invoice.

faqs.question: What if I receive more or fewer items than I ordered?
faqs.answer: Extra units shipped (overruns) are provided at no additional charge, and shortages are billed only for the quantity actually received.

faqs.question: Do you offer custom company/swag stores?
faqs.answer: Custom online storefronts can be built for employees or customers, including product setup, on-demand production, fulfillment, and distribution management.

faqs.question: Can you handle multi-location or multi-department orders?
faqs.answer: Multi-location and multi-department programs are supported, including split shipping and multiple access levels for centralized brand control.

faqs.question: Can you manage inventory, fulfillment, and distribution?
faqs.answer: Inventory management, warehousing, and fulfillment support are available for qualifying ongoing merchandise programs.
